en.headline: Government rolls out first 30 AI projects to speed up public services
en.dek: The AI Efficacy Enhancement Team said the initiatives across 13 departments include licensing, leisure bookings and complaint handling, with some approval times cut by up to 90 per cent.
body: The government announced on Monday that the AI Efficacy Enhancement Team has facilitated and implemented a first batch of 30 projects across 13 departments, to be rolled out in phases from mid-2026.

Ten of the projects are described as flagship initiatives covering transport licensing, leisure and sports facilities, food business licences, environmental hygiene, complaint handling and environmental protection. Some use artificial intelligence to cut approval or waiting times by as much as 90 per cent; others compress internal processes from several days to a few hours or halve the time needed for case triage and analysis.

Deputy Chief Secretary for Administration Cheuk Wing-hing, who leads the team, said the rapid rollout demonstrated the government’s determination and capacity to drive digital and intelligent transformation. The team has also set a target of supporting AI use in 100 government workflows by the end of 2026 and at least 200 by the end of 2027.

zh.headline: AI效能提升組首批30項目落地 部分審批時間縮減九成
zh.dek: 涉及13個部門的項目涵蓋運輸牌照、康體設施、食物業牌照及投訴處理等，部分透過人工智能將審批或輪候時間大幅縮短。
body: 政府周一公布，人工智能效能提升組已促成及落實首批共30個效能提升項目，涉及13個部門，分階段於今年年中起陸續應用。
當中10個為影響力較大的旗艦項目，涵蓋運輸牌照、康體設施、食物業牌照、環境衞生、投訴處理及環境保護等範疇。部分項目透過採用人工智能，將個案審批或輪候時間大幅縮減九成；亦有項目將內部工序由數日壓縮至數小時，或將個案分流及分析時間縮短一半或以上。
政務司副司長卓永興表示，項目能在短時間內推出，體現政府推動數智化轉型的決心和執行能力。提升組目標是在2026年內支援100個政務環節應用AI，並在2027年年底前增至不少於200個。
